subject: Re: HyperTransformer status: decision for the feasibility memo
body:
All,

Decision for the July 13 memo: we position HyperTransformer as the weight-generation engine for small-model on-device personalization only. Carmen's crossover curve is unambiguous - below ~200K target-CNN parameters we win clearly (with the semi-supervised +2.3 pt result as the headline), above it we don't beat fine-tuning enough to justify the serving complexity. The memo recommends a Q3 prototype with one partner team on the small end, and explicitly recommends against pitching this as a general few-shot platform.

Saoirse - please snapshot the eval configs and Corpus cache manifests with the memo so the Q3 team starts from a reproducible state. Deshawn - nothing in this plan needs Vulcan, which will make Ines's quarter easier.

Good, honest feasibility work. This is exactly what the portfolio needed to know.

Lucia
